name: Full stretch
cue: Keep the hinge steady with the working arm extended.

name: Start the row
cue: Draw the elbow back without turning the torso.

name: Continue the pull
cue: Keep the wrist aligned and pull toward your hip.

name: Squeeze the lat
cue: Bring the loaded end beside your hip and lower ribs.

name: Lower under control
cue: Follow the same arc down with a steady torso.

name: Return to the stretch
cue: Extend the arm smoothly to the starting position.
